Load the NOAA wildfires variable description from data/wildfire/input/noaa_wildfires_variabledescrip.csv using cp1252 encoding

operatorProperties.code:
def process(load_vars):
    # Show all variable descriptions to find residential houses damaged column
    return load_vars[load_vars['Variable Name '].str.contains('res|house|struct|damage|resid', case=False, na=False) | 
                     load_vars['Young et al. 2020, Table 1'].str.contains('res|house|struct|damage|resid', case=False, na=False) |
                     load_vars['Alternative description'].str.contains('res|house|struct|damage|resid', case=False, na=False)]

operators.customDisplayName: Filter variable descriptions for columns related to residential houses damaged
Filter variable descriptions for columns related to residential/house/home/dwelling damage
Filter wildfire dataset to only 2008 incidents (start_year == 2008)

operatorProperties.code:
def process(filter_2008) -> pd.DataFrame:
    df = filter_2008[['incident_number', 'prim_threatened_aggregate']].copy()
    df = df.sort_values('prim_threatened_aggregate', ascending=False).reset_index(drop=True)
    
    total = df['prim_threatened_aggregate'].sum()
    df['cumulative'] = df['prim_threatened_aggregate'].cumsum()
    df['cumulative_pct'] = df['cumulative'] / total
    
    # Find the number of fires needed to reach 90% of total houses damaged
    fires_for_90pct = (df['cumulative_pct'] < 0.90).sum() + 1
    total_fires = len(df)
    
    proportion = fires_for_90pct / total_fires
    
    return pd.DataFrame({
        'total_fires': [total_fires],
        'fires_for_90pct': [fires_for_90pct],
        'proportion': [round(proportion, 4)],
        'total_prim_threatened': [total],
        'cumulative_pct_at_threshold': [df.loc[fires_for_90pct - 1, 'cumulative_pct']]
    })

operators.customDisplayName: Pareto analysis: sort 2008 wildfires by prim_threatened_aggregate descending, compute cumulative sum, find the minimum number of fires that account for at least 90% of total residential houses at risk, then compute that count as a proportion of total fires.

operatorProperties.code:
def process(pareto_analysis) -> pd.DataFrame:
    fires_for_90pct = pareto_analysis['fires_for_90pct'].iloc[0]
    total_fires = pareto_analysis['total_fires'].iloc[0]
    proportion = fires_for_90pct / total_fires
    proportion_rounded = round(proportion, 4)
    return pd.DataFrame({
        'fires_for_90pct': [fires_for_90pct],
        'total_fires': [total_fires],
        'exact_proportion': [proportion],
        'proportion_4dp': [proportion_rounded]
    })

operators.customDisplayName: Compute the exact proportion (fires_for_90pct / total_fires) rounded to 4 decimal places.
